title: Floating cargo
text: Barrels bob in the swell, the wreck that spilled them nowhere in sight.

outcomes.text: Good rum and better coin. +15 gold.
One was a powder keg. It goes off against the hull. -5 hull.
You sail on. The crew grumbles.

title: Fishing village
text: A village of stilt houses. The headman offers timber for coin.

choices.text: Buy timber and patch the hull (10 gold)

outcomes.text: Your carpenter gets to work. -10 gold, +8 hull.
They point you to a sunken chest. +10 gold.

title: Survivors on a raft
text: A makeshift raft, a torn sail for a flag, and a dozen sunburnt faces waving at you.

outcomes.text: Grateful sailors, eager to sign on. +10 hands.
Fever came aboard with them. +10 hands, but -10 gold for medicine.

choices.text: Toss them a water cask and sail on

outcomes.text: They curse your name as you leave.
